basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's Richmond District, this fully remodeled 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers 2,543 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space. Renovated down to the studs and expanded to meet modern needs, this home seamlessly blends contemporary elegance with functionality. The main level features an open floor plan with engineered hardwood floors, a bright living room with an updated fireplace, and a chefs kitchen boasting luxury quartz countertops, a waterfall island, top-of-the-line appliances, and abundant custom cabinetry. Down the hall, find two spacious guest bedrooms and a primary suite with a spa-like bath featuring a soaking tub, stall shower, and double vanity. Step outside to a private deck overlooking the freshly landscaped backyard, complete with a fruit-bearing loquat tree. The lower level is perfect for entertaining, offering a large family room with a wet bar, second fireplace with accent shelving, a guest bedroom and full bath and an additional primary ensuite, plus garage access and a dedicated laundry area. Just steps from Golden Gate Park and near top-rated restaurants, cafes, and shops, this home offers easy access to Highway 1, connecting you to downtown San Francisco and Silicon Valley.
